<Preview>
  <goa-button version="2" type="primary">Save</goa-button>
  <goa-button version="2" type="primary" ml="s">Submit</goa-button>
  <goa-button version="2" type="primary" ml="s">Continue</goa-button>

description: Avoid using more than one primary button per page. Multiple primary buttons create visual competition and make it unclear which action is most important.
